title: Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 19: Sienese envoys waiting on the S. Capitano, 9 March, 1440s (unread)

steps.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858) and downloaded the images with the project cookie (survey entry siena1421).
Indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (1433 Petrucci, c. 1440 frate Bernardino and R4749, 1454 Milan ambassadors, Casole, 1478 Bichi, c. 1500 and 16th-c. keys).
No. 19 transcribed from the photograph (agent J): 4 cipher lines, 118 tokens, 37 sign types, clear phrases between the runs.
Alphabets of the fifteenth-century keys of fasc. 1 compared by eye with the sign set: no match.
Homophonic annealing (homsolve2/homsolve3) on the short pieces: no convergence at 118 tokens.
Split out of the survey entry siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry's report of 17 Oct 2026); its transcription moved to this folder; the report lists no. 19 as unsolved.
Compared no. 19 with the key of no. 8 (siena8, c. 1440-41, rebuilt from its contemporary decipherment): a different sign set.

outcome.method_basis: No filed key fits and 118 tokens over 37 signs is too short for ciphertext-only search; no gloss or decipherment.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no19.tok: no token has a value

gaps.detail: no filed key fits; no gloss or decipherment

credits.note: Dated no. 19 to the 1440s in his report ('Sienese envoys, 9 March, 1440s, 112 symbols ... (names only)').
